  4.  Since you are traveling at the speed of light, time dilation occurs, and time appears to pass more slowly for you relative to the child.
  5.  From the child's perspective, time passes normally, so they age at a rate of 1 year per year.
  6.  However, from your perspective, time is slowed down due to time dilation, so you age at a rate of 1 year per year / sqrt(1 - v^2/c^2), where v is your velocity (c = 1 light year per year).

  9.  For v = c = 1 light year per year, the Lorentz factor is γ = 1 / sqrt(1 - 1) = 1 / sqrt(0) = infinity.
